java_model_observations: DescriptionDiagramFactory registers CommandFactoryNoteOnLink single-line before multiline, so a first line consumable by both is owned by the single-line command.
CommandFactoryNoteOnLink builds complete single-line and multiline regexes around the same optional ColorParser leaf, then resolves Colors only in executeInternal after command selection.

ColorParser orders PART2 before ordinary COLOR_REGEXP. PART2 terminates with semicolon or a negative lookahead that excludes word, semicolon, colon, and dot; this is what prevents an immediate body colon from ending keyed PART2.
COLOR_REGEXP can still capture a shorter ordinary color such as #back, #text, or #header before a colon, causing later color resolution to fail terminally.
Colors lowercases and tokenizes the captured expression, retains sparse BACK/LINE/TEXT/HEADER channels plus lineStyle, and maps dotted directive names to their base ColorType via ColorType.getType.

ComponentRoseNote passes Colors only through getSymbolContext(colors), while AbstractTextualComponent constructs its text block from getFontConfiguration() without Colors; Style.getSymbolContext consumes BACK and LINE but calls getStroke() without Colors.
rust_model_observations: parse_deployment_link_note_command now models Java factory ownership by checking single-line suffixes before multiline suffixes, and malformed suffixes under the note-on-link prefix are terminal parse errors.
single_line_link_note_suffix distinguishes PART2 syntax from ordinary syntax and rejects PART2 boundaries at an immediate colon unless a semicolon or Pattern2 whitespace makes the boundary explicit.
parse_plantuml_colors separates syntactic COLOR_REGEXP/PART2 recognition from resolvability and retains TEXT, HEADER, LINE, BACK, shadowing, and line-style channels in the AST.
render_deployment_link_note consumes only BACK and LINE for the folded note shape and emits text/default stroke without consulting TEXT or line_style.
